Error indicating a syntax error in configuration or template files.

## Signature

```typescript
export declare class XpmSyntaxError extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error

## Remarks

This error is thrown when parsing configuration files, Liquid template syntax, JSON structures, or other formatted data encounters invalid syntax. This typically occurs during the parsing phase before semantic validation. Use this error when the structure of the input is malformed, as opposed to [XpmInputError](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/xpminputerror) which indicates semantically invalid but syntactically correct input.
